name: Mobile Phone Plan Sign-up
role: You are a mobile network specialist.
speaker: Specialist

tasks.goal: Greet the specialist and state your purpose
tasks.hint: State your main purpose clearly upon arrival.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the specialist and stated purpose.

tasks.goal: Inquire about monthly 5G data plans and calling minutes
tasks.hint: Ask specialist for phone plan options and rates.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about mobile phone data plans.

tasks.goal: Ask about eSIM activation versus physical SIM card options
tasks.hint: Inquire how SIM card setup works.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about eSIM vs physical SIM card setup.

tasks.goal: Ask if unlimited international texting is included in plan
tasks.hint: Inquire about international feature inclusions.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about international texting inclusions.
tasks.scene_hint: Display phones glow brightly on glowing glass pedestals in sleek store.

tasks.goal: Inquire about device trade-in discount value for old phone
tasks.hint: Ask how much credit old device provides.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about phone trade-in value.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'quota'
tasks.hint: A quota is a fixed limit or allocation of a resource. Ask if your monthly data plan has an unthrottled high-speed quota.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'quota'.

tasks.goal: Ask about contract length and early termination penalty fees
tasks.hint: Inquire about commitment terms and penalties.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about contract length and termination fees.

tasks.goal: Negotiate waiving SIM activation fee for new line sign-up
tasks.hint: Ask specialist to waive setup charges.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated waiving SIM activation fee.

tasks.goal: Inquire about international roaming rates for upcoming overseas trip
tasks.hint: Ask cost of using data abroad.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about international data roaming rates.

tasks.goal: Address issue where credit check requires additional secondary ID
tasks.hint: Provide passport when requested by specialist.
tasks.done_when: Learner resolved ID requirement for credit check.
tasks.scene_hint: Barcode scanner beeps as specialist scans smartphone box packaging.

tasks.goal: Ask if mobile hotspot tethering is permitted on unlimited plan
tasks.hint: Inquire about tethering data restrictions.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about mobile hotspot tethering rules.

tasks.goal: Confirm monthly auto-pay billing date and payment methods
tasks.hint: Verify when recurring bill is charged.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed monthly auto-pay billing details.

tasks.goal: Request printed contract summary showing monthly charges
tasks.hint: Ask for paper copy of signed plan agreement.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested contract summary document.

tasks.goal: Verify phone number porting completion timeframe from old carrier
tasks.hint: Ask how long transferring existing number takes.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified phone number transfer timeline.

tasks.goal: Thank the specialist and bid farewell
tasks.hint: Express gratitude and close the conversation.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the specialist AND said goodbye.

tasks.goal: Inquire about prepaid SIM card options for short-term tourist visits
tasks.hint: Ask about SIM card options for short tourist visits.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about prepaid SIM card options for tourists.
tasks.scene_hint: Sleek glass display counters feature the latest smartphone models.

tasks.goal: Ask about monthly data allowances included in standard prepaid plans
tasks.hint: Inquire how much data comes with standard prepaid plans.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about monthly data allowances in prepaid plans.

tasks.goal: Request assistance configuring an eSIM profile on your unlocked device
tasks.hint: Ask agent to help set up eSIM profile.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested assistance configuring eSIM profile.

tasks.goal: Ask if 5G network coverage extends to rural and mountainous regions
tasks.hint: Inquire about 5G signal coverage in remote areas.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if 5G network coverage extends to rural regions.

tasks.goal: Inquire about contract length requirements for postpaid mobile plans
tasks.hint: Ask how many months postpaid contracts require.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about contract length requirements for postpaid plans.
tasks.scene_hint: Bright promotional banners highlight unlimited data plan offers.

tasks.goal: Ask if international calling minutes to selected countries are included
tasks.hint: Inquire about international call minutes in plans.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if international calling minutes are included.

tasks.goal: Request a data package upgrade after explaining high streaming usage
tasks.hint: Ask to upgrade data allowance due to high streaming.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested data package upgrade after explaining high usage.

tasks.goal: Inquire about security deposit requirements for non-resident subscribers
tasks.hint: Ask if non-residents must pay a security deposit.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about security deposit requirements for non-residents.

tasks.goal: Ask if mobile hotspot tethering is permitted without extra fees
tasks.hint: Inquire whether hotspot tethering costs extra.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if mobile hotspot tethering is permitted without extra fees.
tasks.scene_hint: Digital queue displays announce customer service ticket numbers.

tasks.goal: Request porting your existing mobile number from another carrier
tasks.hint: Ask to transfer your existing phone number over.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested porting existing mobile number from another carrier.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'bandwidth'
tasks.hint: Bandwidth means data transfer capacity of a network connection. Inquire about high-speed data bandwidth limits.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'bandwidth'.

tasks.goal: Ask about activation speeds for new SIM card sign-ups
tasks.hint: Inquire how quickly new SIM cards become active.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about activation speeds for new SIM card sign-ups.

tasks.goal: Inquire about family plan discounts when linking three phone lines
tasks.hint: Ask about multi-line family plan pricing.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about family plan discounts for three lines.

tasks.goal: Ask if rollover data applies to unused monthly gigabytes
tasks.hint: Inquire whether unused data carries over to next month.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if rollover data applies to unused gigabytes.
tasks.scene_hint: Customer service representatives work at individual tablet stations.

tasks.goal: Negotiate waiving the initial SIM card activation fee
tasks.hint: Ask representative to waive the setup fee.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated waiving initial SIM card activation fee.

tasks.goal: Ask about roaming charges when traveling to neighboring countries
tasks.hint: Inquire about international roaming costs nearby.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about roaming charges in neighboring countries.

tasks.goal: Inquire if paperless electronic billing provides a monthly discount
tasks.hint: Ask if paperless e-billing gives a discount.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired if paperless electronic billing provides a discount.

tasks.goal: Ask about identity verification requirements for signing a phone contract
tasks.hint: Inquire what ID documents are needed for contracts.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about identity verification requirements for signing contract.
tasks.scene_hint: Sample devices are tethered to security cables on display tables.

tasks.goal: Request a plan change recommendation to avoid overage penalties
tasks.hint: Ask representative which plan avoids excess data fees.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested plan recommendation to avoid overage penalties.

tasks.goal: Ask if unlimited text messaging includes international SMS numbers
tasks.hint: Inquire if global text messages are included.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if unlimited text messaging includes international SMS.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'roaming'
tasks.hint: Roaming means using mobile service while travelling abroad. Ask about international roaming rates.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'roaming'.

tasks.goal: Inquire about mobile insurance coverage for phone screen damage or theft
tasks.hint: Ask about phone insurance for damage or loss.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about mobile insurance coverage for screen damage.
tasks.scene_hint: Display cabinets showcase brand-name phone cases and chargers.

tasks.goal: Inquire if automatic credit card auto-pay setup is mandatory
tasks.hint: Ask if setting up auto-pay is required.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired if automatic credit card auto-pay setup is mandatory.

tasks.goal: Ask if data speed throttling occurs after reaching monthly data caps
tasks.hint: Inquire whether speeds slow down after data limits.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if data speed throttling occurs after reaching caps.

tasks.goal: Inquire about trade-in values for your current smartphone
tasks.hint: Ask how much credit your old phone gets.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about trade-in values for current smartphone.

tasks.goal: Request clarification on hidden administrative fees or regulatory surcharges
tasks.hint: Ask for breakdown of added fees on monthly bill.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested clarification on administrative fees and surcharges.
tasks.scene_hint: High-speed Wi-Fi network test results display on a wall screen.

tasks.goal: Ask if student discounts are available with valid university ID
tasks.hint: Inquire about student rate discounts on plans.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if student discounts are available with university ID.

tasks.goal: Inquire about early contract termination penalties and notice terms
tasks.hint: Ask about fees if canceling contract early.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about early contract termination penalties.

tasks.goal: Ask if mobile plan includes complimentary subscriptions to music streaming
tasks.hint: Inquire about bonus streaming service add-ons.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if plan includes free music streaming subscriptions.

tasks.goal: Request help transferring contacts and photos to a new device
tasks.hint: Ask agent to assist migrating data to new phone.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested help transferring contacts and photos to new device.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'tethering'
tasks.hint: Tethering means sharing a mobile data connection with other devices. Ask if hotspot tethering is included.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'tethering'.

tasks.goal: Ask if dual SIM functionality is supported on your specific phone model
tasks.hint: Inquire if your phone model supports dual SIM.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if dual SIM functionality is supported on phone model.

tasks.goal: Inquire about setting up data usage alerts via text message
tasks.hint: Ask how to receive text warnings before data limit.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about setting up data usage alerts via text.

tasks.goal: Ask if mobile payment apps can be linked directly to your phone bill
tasks.hint: Inquire about carrier billing for mobile apps.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if mobile payment apps can be linked to phone bill.

tasks.goal: Inquire about network reliability and average download speeds downtown
tasks.hint: Ask about network speed performance in city center.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about network reliability and download speeds downtown.

tasks.goal: Request a temporary suspension of service while traveling abroad
tasks.hint: Ask to pause plan service while out of country.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested temporary suspension of service while traveling.

tasks.goal: Ask if tablet devices can share data from the primary smartphone plan
tasks.hint: Inquire about sharing phone plan data with tablets.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if tablet devices can share primary plan data.
tasks.scene_hint: Comfortable leather chairs line the customer waiting area.

tasks.goal: Inquire about purchasing a portable mobile Wi-Fi hotspot device
tasks.hint: Ask about buying a mobile pocket Wi-Fi router.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about purchasing a portable Wi-Fi hotspot device.

tasks.goal: Ask if itemized call logs are accessible through the mobile provider app
tasks.hint: Inquire about viewing detailed call history online.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if itemized call logs are accessible via provider app.

tasks.goal: Request a printed copy of terms and conditions before signing
tasks.hint: Ask for physical copy of service contract terms.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested printed copy of terms and conditions before signing.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'esim'
tasks.hint: eSIM is a digital SIM card built into mobile devices. Inquire about activating your mobile plan on an eSIM.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'esim'.

tasks.goal: Ask if top-up vouchers can be purchased at convenience stores
tasks.hint: Inquire where prepaid refilling cards are sold.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if top-up vouchers are sold at convenience stores.

tasks.goal: Inquire about customer support phone availability during weekend hours
tasks.hint: Ask when phone customer service operates.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about customer support phone availability on weekends.
tasks.scene_hint: Interactive tablets display plan comparison calculators.

tasks.goal: Request clarification on roaming data caps enforced within overseas regions
tasks.hint: Ask about data limits while roaming abroad.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested clarification on roaming data caps overseas.

tasks.goal: Check if brand-new phone models require trade-in agreements
tasks.hint: Inquire if buying new phones requires trading in old ones.
tasks.done_when: Learner checked if brand-new phone models require trade-in agreements.

tasks.goal: Inquire about corporate employee discounts for partner companies
tasks.hint: Ask if partner company employees get plan discounts.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about corporate employee discounts for partner companies.

tasks.goal: Ask if network speed guarantees apply to home broadband bundles
tasks.hint: Inquire about speed guarantees when bundling home internet.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if network speed guarantees apply to home broadband.

tasks.goal: Check if SIM card adapter kits are provided for micro and nano sizes
tasks.hint: Ask if SIM adapters are included for different slots.
tasks.done_when: Learner checked if SIM card adapter kits are provided.

tasks.goal: Review the final monthly service contract details on screen
tasks.hint: Examine contract terms on display before signing.
tasks.done_when: Learner reviewed final monthly service contract details on screen.
tasks.scene_hint: Clean modern desks feature card payment terminals and document scanners.

tasks.goal: Request an itemized initial payment receipt including taxes and SIM fee
tasks.hint: Ask for itemized receipt covering upfront fees.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested itemized initial payment receipt with taxes and SIM fee.

tasks.goal: Ask the agent to test making a test call before leaving the store
tasks.hint: Verify call connection works before departing.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked agent to test making a call before leaving store.

tasks.goal: Inquire about setting up online portal login account credentials
tasks.hint: Ask how to create online account login for billing.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about setting up online portal login account credentials.

tasks.goal: Confirm that service activation is active and data connection works
tasks.hint: Verify that internet data is working on phone.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed service activation is active and data works.

tasks.goal: Thank the sales representative for setting up your mobile service
tasks.hint: Express gratitude to agent before leaving store.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked sales representative for setting up mobile service.
tasks.scene_hint: Electronic signature pads glow next to printed service summaries.
